description: Implement a complete database audit and customer loyalty system for the Sakila DVD rental database using MySQL Workbench (host: localhost, user: ga, password: password123). The supporting tables have already been created. Complete all of the following: (1) Create an AFTER UPDATE trigger named tr_customer_audit on sakila.customer that fires when any row is updated — the trigger must INSERT a record into sakila.customer_audit_log containing the customer_id (from OLD row), the old email address (OLD.email), the new email address (NEW.email), and the change timestamp (NOW()); (2) Create a stored procedure named sp_calculate_loyalty_tiers() in sakila that populates the sakila.customer_loyalty table by categorizing every customer into tiers based on their total rental count: 'Bronze' for 0–5 rentals, 'Silver' for 6–20 rentals, 'Gold' for 21 or more rentals — the procedure should first DELETE all existing rows from customer_loyalty, then INSERT the categorized rows; (3) Test the trigger by executing UPDATE statements on at least 5 different customer email addresses; (4) Call CALL sp_calculate_loyalty_tiers() to populate the loyalty table; (5) Export the contents of sakila.customer_loyalty to /home/ga/Documents/exports/customer_loyalty.csv.
